 From Premier League star to Twitch: former England international finds an unexpected career path
 From Premier League star to Twitch: former England international finds an unexpected career path
 Dele Alli has already gained 150,000 followers on the streaming platform 
 Football news 
 Yesterday, 12:08
 Add Dailysports on Google 
 Photo: x.com/TouchlineX 
 Dele Alli’s story has taken an unexpected turn. The former Tottenham and England midfielder has tried his hand at streaming on Twitch and has already amassed around 150,000 followers. It remains unclear whether this will mark a new chapter in the footballer’s life or merely be a temporary pastime during his break from professional football.
 🚨 Dele Alli’s career has taken an unexpected turn! The former Tottenham star has turned to Twitch streaming and has already gained 150K followers. Will we ever see him back on the football pitch? https://t.co/61pAqH5ei3
 — 𝐏𝐢𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐏𝐮𝐥𝐬𝐞 (@_PitchPulseHQ) October 24, 2026 
 It was previously reported that the player had been training with amateur club Windsor & Eton, who compete in the eighth tier of English football. The sessions helped him maintain his fitness and stay sharp.
 The last club of the 30-year-old Englishman was Italian side Como. The two parties terminated his contract in September 2025, and Alli made just one appearance for the team during his time there. Since then, the midfielder has been working to regain his form and find an opportunity to return to the football pitch.
 Read also: PSG vs Lyon: Can PSG Continue Their Winning Run? 
 Just a few years ago, Alli was regarded as one of England’s most promising footballers. He enjoyed considerable success in the Premier League with Tottenham and also represented the England national team.
